info.title: qmdoc
info.description: Tool to convert documentation and markdown files to pretty-looking PDF (also supports DOCX).

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Runs the full Markdown to PDF conversion.

options.name: --source
options.description: File or directory that represents the source files. [default: ./]

options.name: --target
options.description: Directory to store the resulting files to. [default: ./]

options.name: --title
options.description: The title of the document. If empty, the file name will be used.

options.name: --include-html
options.description: Saves the HTML version of the content into a file. [default: False]

options.name: --placeholders
options.description: Path to an optional JSON file that contains placeholders to be merged into the resulting document. [default: placeholders.json]

options.name: --ignore-git-commits-since
options.description: All Git commits before this date will not be shown in Git Placeholders (eg. "2022-12-31").

options.name: --ignore-git-commits
options.description: A list of Git commit SHAs or parts of Git SHAs (comma separated) that should not be shown in Git Placeholders (eg. "d53ba669, b0d71fe388").

options.name: --ignore-git-commits-without
options.description: A list of words (comma separated). If a commit message does not contain any of these words, the Git commit will not be shown in Git Placeholders (eg. "Freigabe, For Training")

options.name: --disable-header-numbering
options.description: Disables numbering of headers. [default: False]

options.name: --theme
options.description: The name of the theme that should be used.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
